name: Specimen Rule
mechanic: Compress labeled specimens into a nearest-prototype classifier
distinction: Select three or four training prototypes from eight labeled specimens. Each reference inherits the label of its nearest selected prototype by Manhattan distance: |X difference| + |Y difference|. If equally near prototypes disagree, the result is ambiguous. Match all twelve printed reference labels within the prototype budget. Adding or removing one prototype can change several predictions. Every slot is necessary and at least two valid prototype sets exist. Three incorrect audits end the study; complete three different feature landscapes.
